name: Monaco Zeera
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED OILS (PALMOLEIN, PALM), SUGAR, RAISING AGENTS [503 (ii), 500 (ii), 341 (i)], INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, IODISED SALT (2.4%), ZEERA (2.3%), YEAST, ACIDITY REGULATORS [270, 296], EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN (472e) AND FLOUR TREATMENT AGENTS [223, 1101(ii), 1100(i)]. CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOUR (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - BUTTER).
